name: Butt Kicks
instructions: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart. Jog in place while kicking your heels back to touch or come close to your glutes on each stride.
Keep your knees pointed toward the ground rather than driving them forward, and pump your arms naturally as you maintain a quick cadence.
Butt kicks are a common warm-up and cardio drill that emphasize hamstring flexion. A 150 lb person will burn around 300 calories doing butt kicks for 30 minutes.
